title: CLO 2024 Course: Summer Essentials! CLO teaches you how to create 3D fashion sun protection clothing!
description: In the scorching summer, learn how to create essential summer items—3D sunscreen garments—with CLO! CLO technical expert Lydia will guide you through the entire process, from basic jacket modification to the final product presentation, while using PBR textures and texture preset features to enhance your design! Hurry and start learning to keep cool this summer with CLO! For free materials from this live broadcast, please reply "free materials" in the background of the "CLO3D" official account.
